framesPolicy: never use XBRL Frames to select a fact for one issuer; preserve an existing frame value only as evidence metadata
orderedPrecedence: stable accessionNumber ascending as deterministic tie-break only when values are equal
duplicatePolicy: collapse exact duplicate values inside one selectionGroup while preserving every sourceRef
amendmentPolicy: an amendment may replace only facts it actually contains; absence in an amendment never deletes an original fact
restatementPolicy: a later eligible filing may restate a comparative prior period and takes precedence when lineage, unit, period and scope are compatible
conflictPolicy: different values with identical effective precedence are ambiguous/conflicting; do not choose silently and do not emit a metric value
unitPolicy: no inferred unit conversion; unit must be exact and allowed by mapping/metric
partialHistoryPolicy: follow Submissions files[] in declared order within the 14-call operation budget; exhausted history produces partial with evidence
